page_note: Page is dominated by cosmological substrate teaching: chapter 53 'Concerning the Molding of Man' opens after a brief closing exhortation (segs 0-3) of chapter 52. The teaching narrates the sending forth of the Molding of Man into the cosmic war, the garment of Living Fire, the running at Matter/Enthumesis, the Living Spirit and archons, the storehouses of the elements, and a sustained simile (lake/lions) likening the Land of Darkness to an emptied storehouse. Heavy physical damage (72%), but what survives is systematic cosmogonic narrative — pre-Manichaean correspondential substrate. Editorial fatigue score is sharply NEGATIVE (-0.69), confirming the second half is even purer substrate than the first. Only the chapter heading apparatus (segs 4-5) and the frame opener (seg 6) are clearly editorial.
